CLM-PHOT-0047.statement: The narrowest emission linewidth for reference InAs/GaAs quantum dots with a 95nm GaAs capping layer is 0.04nm under non-resonant laser excitation at cryogenic temperatures.

extra_quotes: For time-resolved photoluminescence experiments, the photoluminescence (PL) from the sample is spectrally filtered by a 0.75m spectrometer equipped with a 1200 lines/mm grating that allows isolating specific emission lines. These are then coupled into a single-mode fibre leading to superconducting nanowire single-photon detectors, connected to a time-tagger.
As discussed, our spectra are measured under non-resonant excitation, condition where linewidths are larger than transform-limited values.
